away.summary: The Panthers (9-6-2) are missing several key players, including Aleksander Barkov, Brad Marchand, and Anton Lundell, though Lundell is day to day. Brady Tkachuk is projected to center the top line alongside Sam Bennett and Matthew Tkachuk, while Carter Verhaeghe is on a five-game point streak. Jacob Markstrom is the projected starting goaltender.

out.detail: upper body injury (broke nose), game-time decision
back injury, placed on injured reserve

doubtful.detail: not 100 percent, could play if needed

home.summary: The Bruins (12-4-1) are without James Hagens (IR) and have Matthew Poitras questionable after breaking his nose. Mikey Eyssimont was recalled and will play, while Frederic Brunet re-enters the lineup on defense with Clifton and Aspirot scratched. Jeremy Swayman is projected to start in net.
